notes.form: るところ / ているところ / たところ
notes.formation: Dictionary verb + ところだ/です for the stage just before action; ている + ところだ/です during action; た + ところだ/です immediately after action. Before nouns or ので use the nominal construction correctly; do not add だ mechanically before ので.
notes.teachingChoice: Three temporal stages contrast in a phone call. Bridge N4-mapped forms not explicitly taught in the installed core. Do not score a future action as already complete. Near-miss ところだった, connector ところで and factual discovery たところ are different extensions and are not inferred from this introductory stage contrast.

notes.formation: Verb た-form + ばかりだ/です; an attributive noun phrase uses たばかりの + noun. In a cause clause, たばかりなので, not たばかりだので.
notes.teachingChoice: Subjective recency differs from the immediate just-finished stage. Do not invent a fixed elapsed-time cutoff. In an immediately completed context both たところ and たばかり can be defensible, so never use them as competing answers without a decisive context or an explicitly stated form task.

notes.form: うちに — act before a state changes
notes.formation: Noun + のうちに; な-adjective + なうちに; い-adjective + うちに; a suitable plain nonpast/ない/ている verb clause + うちに.
notes.teachingChoice: Teach a useful temporary window, with explicit constraints in a notice or phone plan. A stated end of availability can support an inference about acting before that time. A task must not manufacture a closing time that the text never gives.

notes.form: うちに — change emerging during activity
notes.formation: An ongoing/repeated plain clause + うちに, followed by an emerging change. Examples must make the temporal development clear rather than imply a deadline or a purposeful command.
notes.teachingChoice: Contrast incidental/gradual change with the window for a deliberate action. Recycle N3 unit 1 observed-change forms and record/method vocabulary from N4 units 10–12. Revisit alongside 間 and 最中 in unit 10; do not treat every translation of English 'while' as interchangeable.
